column1: # Untradeable non-GP currencies, unpriced unless a manual override supplies a price.
# item id <TAB> RuneLite gameval ItemID name (or the item's name where no constant is used)
# Proxy rows instead read: item id <TAB> proxy item id <TAB> units per proxy item or base/with-gloves <TAB> name.
# A shard is one hundred-and-fiftieth of an enhanced crystal teleport seed, the most
# A tokkul reads at the uncut onyx exchange: 300,000 tokkul per onyx, or 260,000 while Karamja gloves are worn.
# A degrading Amulet of the damned is worth its full self until it turns to dust (OSRS Wiki).
# Spirit flakes read at the retired sailor's exchange: 6,000 flakes buy a barrel or tackle box,
# swapped for 25 soaked pages, so a page is 240 flakes (OSRS Wiki valuation).
# Molch pearls read at Alry's exchange: a golden tench is worth 100 pearls.
# Known-currency guards with no fixed exchange: the hallowed mark counting variants, Castle Wars
# tickets and Soul Wars spoils stay unpriced rather than mapping to a wrong item.
# Imbuing keeps an item's worth: imbued black masks and slayer helmets (NMZ, Soul Wars, PvP Arena)
# are worth the plain black mask, so an imbue is neutral (owner 2026-10-09).
# Imbuing keeps an item's worth: every 1:1 row also makes an X to X(i)/(ei)/(ri) swap neutral, so
#   an imbue never books a loss and a gain (owner 2026-10-12).
# The sailors' amulet never de-charges: its inert state swaps 1:1 for the charged one, so charging
#   books only the law and water runes it takes and the amulet's own states stay unvalued
